rows.note: Use this all-purpose choice when something does not conform to what is considered normal, especially with a mildly negative implication.

example.english: The way you’re doing this is really atypical.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 zan1 hai6 m4 zing3 soeng4

rows.note: Use this for something noticeably unusual or out of the ordinary without necessarily suggesting a defect.

example.english: The atmosphere at this game is atypical.
example.traditional: 呢次嘅比賽氣氛唔尋常。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 ge3 bei2 coi3 hei3 fan1 m4 cam4 soeng4

rows.note: Use this when the atypical thing seems odd, strange, or unsettling rather than merely uncommon.

example.english: This house feels a bit atypical at night.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 uk1 je6 maan5 jau5 di1 gu2 gwaai3
